description: Compute the change owed for a payment/tender pair (amount tendered minus amount due) and break that change down into the minimum count of bills/coins from the given denominations.

amountTendered.description: The amount paid, must be greater than or equal to amountDue

denominations.description: Available bill/coin denominations, largest to smallest (defaults to US denominations: 100, 50, 20, 10, 5, 1, 0.25, 0.1, 0.05, 0.01)

name: calculate_change
